entries.zh: 每；各（汉栏作“独”，闽语以“独独”表“每”）；每年
entries.en: each; every one; every year

entries.zh: 各；每；各不相同
entries.en: each; every one; each one different
entries.notes: 西栏 “o Mo” 疑为缩写未获确解，展开依赖推断；汉栏“各”与闽、官两栏对音相合，词义取“各、各不相同”。

entries.zh: 各处；每一地方
entries.en: each place; every place

entries.zh: 各份；每份；各一
entries.en: each part; each share; each one

entries.zh: 每一个；各个；逐个（汉栏“独独”）
entries.en: each and every one; every single one

entries.zh: 每年；年年
entries.en: every year; year after year; annually

entries.zh: 往年；过往每年
entries.en: every past year; in years gone by

entries.zh: 一天比一天好；越来越好（汉栏“那好那好”）
entries.en: better every day; better and better

entries.zh: 同一副面孔；相貌相同（汉栏“一樣面”；西栏字面义为“各人有各人的形貌”，两栏相龃龉）
entries.en: same face / alike in appearance (Chinese column); Spanish headword reads 'each one has his own figure/face' - columns disagree
entries.notes: 西栏与汉栏语义相左（各具形貌 vs 同一面孔），取汉栏为主并降级存疑。

entries.zh: 每天；平日；平常日子（汉栏“常日”）
entries.en: every day; on ordinary days; daily

entries.zh: 素日；平日；平时
entries.en: ordinary days; as a rule; in ordinary times

entries.zh: 每天；日日；天天
entries.en: every day; day after day

entries.zh: 各不相同；各个不同（汉栏首二字“各／苦”难辨，后接“各别”）
entries.en: each one different; every one unlike the other
entries.notes: 汉栏首二字标[疑:各/苦]，据闽栏对音推定为“各各”，“各别”义为各不相同。

entries.zh: 同声相应；同类相和、各随其类
entries.en: like sounds answer each other; each responds according to its kind; like attracts like

entries.zh: 随地风俗：各地风俗各不相同；随乡入俗
entries.en: customs vary from place to place; each place has its own customs (local law / fuero)
entries.notes: 西栏 “fueguil” 非规范西语词形，疑为 fuero/usos 之类俗写误读，据汉栏“随地风俗”推断而降级。

entries.zh: 链条；锁链（汉栏“鍊”）
entries.en: chain

entries.zh: 铁链
entries.en: iron chain

entries.zh: 锁；锁链（汉栏“鎖”，兼指锁具与链索）
entries.en: any chain; lock

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（汉栏“項蛇”字面“颈蛇”，姑拟为颈间蛇形链饰／项链）
entries.en: [defective in the original, gloss uncertain] - Spanish fragment 'cadena p̃a ...' largely lost; Chinese column '項蛇' suggests a snake-shaped neck chain / necklace
entries.notes: 西栏标[残]，“p̃a arrael liellos”无法复原，据汉栏“項蛇”姑拟“颈间蛇形链饰”，证据不足。

entries.zh: 蠟蛇：蜡蛇（蜡制蛇形物，或指蛇形蜡烛）〔西栏“带蜡烛之链”与汉栏语义不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: wax snake (Chinese column); Spanish headword reads 'a chain with a wax candle' - columns disagree, gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 西栏与汉栏语义不合（带蜡烛之链 vs 蜡蛇），孰为原文无法定夺，降为低置信。
